sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: Four robbers armed with a gun and knives boarded a ship underway. They entered the engine room, threatened one crew, stole engine spares and escaped. The crew informed the Master. General alarm raised, PA announcement made and SSAS activated. Incident reported to VTIS. Upon anchoring, the vessel was boarded by the coast guard for investigations.
